reason: I'd rather wire an LLM API into my own site than pay a SaaS, and I'm not convinced a mascot is a real driver of sign-ups. I might try the free plan, but paying within the first month is unlikely.
objection: Will it actually increase sales or sign-ups, or is it a gimmick? I can build a RAG chat with actions myself, and a cute character feels like decoration until I see measured lift.
would_change_my_mind: A real A/B result from a comparable site showing a clear lift in sign-ups, after I've tested the free plan on my own traffic and the lift shows up in my numbers.
